descriptionMarkdown:
Species Available Classes Notes
Human Veteran, Zealot, Psyker, Arbites 
Enforcer, Hive Scum Most flexible Imperial species.
Ogryn Ogryn Skullbreaker Class-locked; variety comes from Ogryn 
roles and talents.
Ratling Ratling Sharpshooter, Veteran, Hive 
Scum
Sniper, scout, thief, cook and rogue-style 
specialist.
Skitarii Skitarii Veteran Mechanicus-only; no psychic access.
Squat / Kin Kin Armsman, Hernkyn Prospector Tough, technically capable specialist; 
rare in Imperial warbands.
Aeldari / Eldar Aeldari Outcast, Aeldari Warlock Xenos option for unusual campaigns; 
should require a strong narrative reason.
